environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS ALB configured with HTTP listener on port 80. No client certificate validation is configured on the ALB - it operates in standard HTTP mode. The service trusts X-Client-Cert-Fingerprint header directly from any incoming request. An attacker can send arbitrary headers to create sessions and then trigger the null dereference on the admin/query endpoints, causing 500 errors with stack traces that leak internal paths and session state.
